items.exampleZh: 不要把 their 和 there 搞混。

items.exampleEn: Cats look so peaceful when they sleep.
items.exampleZh: 貓睡覺時看起來好平靜。

items.exampleEn: We are grateful to the doctors.

items.exampleZh: 她問了一個很聰明的問題。

items.exampleEn: The weather was pleasant all week.
items.exampleZh: 整個星期的天氣都很宜人。

items.exampleEn: My dog gets anxious when I leave.
items.exampleZh: 我出門時，我的狗會焦慮不安。

items.exampleEn: Her face was full of happiness.
Dad looked disappointed when he saw my grades.
items.exampleZh: 爸爸看到我的成績時，看起來很失望。

items.sentenceEn: I'm grateful for all your help.
items.sentenceZh: 我很感謝你所有的幫忙。

items.audioEn: I felt anxious before my exam, but it went well.
items.audioZh: 考試前我很緊張，不過考得很順利。

items.sentenceEn: The map confused me, so I asked for help.
items.sentenceZh: 那張地圖讓我搞不清楚，所以我找人幫忙。

items.stemEn: After a busy week, I love the ____ mornings at the lake.
items.stemZh: 忙了一週之後，我很喜歡湖邊平靜的早晨。

items.stemEn: I was ____ because our team lost the game.
items.stemZh: 我們隊輸了比賽，我很失望。

items.passageEn: Before her piano exam, Amy felt anxious. The music was hard, and some notes confused her. Her teacher, a pleasant and intelligent woman, said, "Just play and enjoy it." Amy did her best, but she made two mistakes and felt disappointed. Later, her teacher called with good news: Amy passed! She was so grateful. That night, the house felt quiet and peaceful.
items.passageZh: 鋼琴考試前，Amy 覺得很緊張。曲子很難，有些音符讓她搞不清楚。她的老師是一位親切又聰明的女士，對她說：「好好享受彈琴就好。」Amy 盡了全力，但還是彈錯了兩個地方，覺得很失望。後來老師打電話來報喜：Amy 通過了！她非常感激。那天晚上，家裡感覺又安靜又平和。

questions.questionZh: 考試前 Amy 覺得怎麼樣？

referenceEn: I was disappointed with this movie.
I was very disappointed with this film.
rubricZh: 「失望的」可寫，例如 disappointed 等
可寫例如 I was disappointed with…

items.instructionZh: 用 grateful 造一個句子，說說你感謝的人或事。
referenceEn: I am grateful to my parents for everything.
I am grateful for my good friends.
rubricZh: grateful 常接 for＋事物、to＋人（例如 grateful for…、grateful to…）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 I am grateful）

Later, her teacher called with good news: Amy passed! She was so grateful. That night, the house felt quiet and peaceful."（原 "Before her piano exam, Amy felt anxious. The music was hard, and some notes confused her. Her teacher, a pleasant and intelligent woman, said, \"Just play with happiness.\" Amy did her best, but she made two mistakes and felt disappointed. Later, her teacher called with good news: Amy passed! She was so grateful. That night, the house felt quiet and peaceful."）；happiness 另有其他題
